summary: DeepEval is essentially pytest for LLM systems: you define test cases, plug in metrics like G-Eval, task completion, or tool correctness, and it scores your agent's full trajectory step by step locally, no cloud round-trip required. For PenguPool, where I route multiple agent sessions and need to know whether a sub-agent actually called the right tool with the right arguments before handing off to the next one, having a deterministic eval layer that checks plan adherence and step efficiency is the kind of observability I've been bolting together by hand. It also makes the "trust" part of my local-first philosophy concrete: you can regression-test a prompt change or a model swap without guessing whether quality silently drifted.
